description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React app by attaching it to the DOM element with id 'root' and renders the App component inside React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the app into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM.
